Players Committee card image of [[Intimidator & •Persecutor]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploys -4 to Scarif or opponent's system. May add 4 pilots, 4 TIEs, and 2 vehicles. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 4. While at Scarif, subtracts 2 from attempts to 'blow away' Shield Gate.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c241f88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/intimidatorpersecutor.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/intimidatorpersecutor.png] as of commit c241f88 “vset14” (18 March 2021).
